about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Albanian Baked Lamb and Rice with Yoghurt Crust
recipes.summary: Tender lamb and rice baked under a golden egg and yoghurt crust, inspired by Albanian tave kosi.
steps: Heat the oven to 180C. Heat the oil in a frying pan and brown the lamb over high heat for 6 minutes until coloured, then add the onion, garlic and oregano for 3 minutes until soft.
Tip the lamb mixture into a baking dish with the rice, water and salt, cover with foil and bake for 40 minutes until the lamb and rice are tender.
Whisk the yoghurt, eggs and flour until smooth, pour over the dish and dust with paprika.
Bake uncovered for 20 minutes until the top is set and golden.
notes: Let the dish stand for 5 minutes before serving so the crust firms up.
Food safety: cook the lamb until very tender and at least 75°C inside, and the egg topping until fully set; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: Bulgarian Cheese and Egg Filo Squares
recipes.summary: Crisp filo layered with eggs, yoghurt and feta, baked and cut into squares in the style of banitsa.
steps: Heat the oven to 180C and grease a 20cm square dish.
Whisk the eggs, yoghurt, feta, pepper and baking soda in a bowl until combined.
Brush each filo sheet with butter, scrunch it loosely and layer in the dish, spooning some of the filling between layers until all is used.
Bake for 35 minutes until deep golden and the filling is set in the centre. Rest for 10 minutes and cut into squares.
notes: Keep unused filo covered with a damp tea towel so it does not dry out.
Food safety: bake until the egg filling is fully set with no wet centre.

recipes.title: Eritrean Chickpea and Egg Breakfast Scramble
recipes.summary: Chickpeas and eggs scrambled with onion, tomato and mild spices, scooped up with bread.
steps: Heat the oil in a frying pan and cook the onion and chilli for 5 minutes over medium heat until soft.
Add the tomato, cumin and turmeric and cook for 3 minutes until the tomato breaks down, then stir in the chickpeas for 2 minutes until hot.
Pour in the eggs and salt and stir gently over low heat for 3 minutes until set with no liquid egg remaining.
Scatter with coriander and serve with bread.
notes: Mash a few of the chickpeas for a creamier scramble.
Food safety: cook eggs until fully set; avoid undercooked eggs for young children, pregnant women and older adults.

recipes.title: Beetroot and Apple Slaw with Horseradish Yoghurt
recipes.summary: A vivid raw beetroot and apple slaw dressed with a sharp horseradish yoghurt.
steps: Toss the beetroot, apple, cabbage and dill in a large bowl.
Whisk the yoghurt, horseradish, lemon juice, honey and salt in a small bowl until smooth.
Pour the dressing over the slaw and toss until coated, then chill for 10 minutes before serving.
notes: Wear gloves when grating the beetroot to avoid staining your hands.
Add the dressing just before serving to keep the colour bright.

recipes.title: Shredded Kale Salad with Shaved Cheese and Lemon
recipes.summary: Finely shredded kale massaged with lemon and olive oil, topped with shaved parmesan and toasted breadcrumbs.

items: 300g kale, stems removed and thinly shredded

steps: Toast the breadcrumbs in 1 tsp oil in a dry pan for 3 minutes until golden and crisp.
Place the kale in a large bowl with the oil, lemon juice, garlic and salt and massage for 2 minutes until the leaves soften and darken.
Top with the cheese and breadcrumbs and serve.
notes: Let it sit for 10 minutes for a more tender salad.
Slice the kale as thinly as you can.

recipes.title: Indian Cabbage Thoran with Coconut
recipes.summary: A dry south Indian stir-fry of finely shredded cabbage with mustard seeds and coconut.
steps: Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium heat and add the mustard seeds until they pop.
Add the onion and chilli and cook for 4 minutes until soft, then stir in the turmeric.
Add the cabbage and salt and stir-fry for 5 minutes until just tender and still bright.
Stir through the coconut and coriander for 1 minute until warm, and serve.
notes: Do not add water; the cabbage releases enough as it cooks.
Great beside rice and dal.

recipes.title: Indian Palak Dal Spinach Lentils
recipes.summary: Red lentils simmered with spinach, garlic and cumin for a quick, comforting dal.
steps: Rinse the lentils and simmer with the water and turmeric for 20 minutes until soft and creamy.
Heat the ghee in a small pan and fry the cumin seeds, garlic, onion and ginger for 6 minutes until golden.
Stir the spinach into the lentils for 2 minutes until wilted, then add the salt and lemon juice.
Pour the spiced onion mix over the top and serve with rice.
notes: Skim off any foam from the lentils as they start to simmer.
Add a little water if the dal thickens too much.

recipes.title: Persian Herbed Rice with Dill and Peas
recipes.summary: Fragrant basmati rice cooked with plenty of dill, parsley and peas, with a golden crust if you like.
steps: Rinse the rice, then boil in a large pot of salted water for 7 minutes until just tender, adding the peas for the last 2 minutes, and drain.
Mix the dill and parsley through the rice.
Heat the oil, butter and turmeric in the pot, spoon in the rice, cover with a tea towel and lid and cook on low for 20 minutes until steamed through and the base is crisp.
Fluff and serve, breaking up the crust.
notes: Wrap the lid in a tea towel to catch steam and keep the rice fluffy.
Delicious alongside grilled chicken or lamb.

recipes.title: Spanish Rice with Peas and Paprika
recipes.summary: A simple one-pan rice with smoked paprika, tomato and peas, a Spanish-style side.
steps: Heat the oil in a wide pan and cook the onion for 5 minutes over medium heat until soft.
Add the garlic, paprika and rice and stir for 2 minutes until coated, then add the tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes until thick.
Pour in the stock and salt, bring to a simmer, cover and cook on low for 12 minutes until the rice is tender, adding the peas for the last 3 minutes.
Rest for 5 minutes, fluff and serve with lemon.
notes: Do not stir after adding the stock for fluffier rice.
Add a pinch of saffron if you have it.

recipes.title: Roasted Broccoli with Cheese and Lemon Crumbs
recipes.summary: Crisp-edged roasted broccoli finished with parmesan and a lemony toasted crumb.
steps: Heat the oven to 220C. Toss the broccoli with 2 tbsp oil and the salt on a tray.
Roast for 15 minutes until charred at the edges and tender.
Mix the crumbs, cheese, zest, garlic and remaining oil, scatter over the broccoli and roast for 5 minutes until golden.
Squeeze over the lemon juice and serve hot.
notes: Dry the broccoli well before roasting for better browning.
Add a pinch of chilli flakes for heat.

recipes.title: Grilled Capsicum with Garlic and Parsley Oil
recipes.summary: Charred red capsicum strips dressed in garlic, parsley and good olive oil.
steps: Grill or roast the capsicums at 230C for 20 minutes, turning, until the skin is blistered and black.
Place in a covered bowl for 10 minutes, then peel, deseed and slice into strips.
Toss with the oil, garlic, parsley, vinegar and salt and serve at room temperature.
notes: Keep the juices that collect in the bowl for the dressing.
Good with crusty bread and cheese.

recipes.title: Charred Spring Onions with Almond Dressing
recipes.summary: Sweet charred spring onions served on a nutty almond and garlic dressing.
steps: Toss the spring onions with 2 tbsp oil and grill on a hot pan for 8 minutes, turning, until charred and tender.
Blitz the almonds, garlic, vinegar, remaining oil, soaked bread and salt in a blender with 3 tbsp water until a coarse sauce forms.
Spread the sauce on a platter, lay the spring onions on top and serve warm.
notes: Use a smoky paprika pinch to echo the char.
Trim the roots, but leave the white ends intact so the onions hold together.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Cakes with Spring Onion and Cheddar
recipes.summary: Crisp grated potato cakes with spring onion and cheddar, perfect beside eggs.
steps: Squeeze the grated potato in a clean tea towel until very dry.
Mix with the spring onion, cheddar, egg, flour, salt and pepper, then shape into 8 patties.
Fry in the oil over medium heat for 5 minutes each side until deep golden and cooked through.
Drain on paper towel and serve hot.
notes: Squeezing out the moisture is the secret to crisp edges.
Food safety: cook until the potato is tender and the egg is cooked through.

recipes.title: Creamy Polenta with Cheese and Black Pepper
recipes.summary: Creamy polenta stirred with butter, parmesan and plenty of black pepper.
steps: Bring the water and salt to a simmer in a heavy saucepan and pour in the polenta in a thin stream, whisking until smooth.
Cook on low heat for 20 minutes, stirring often, until thick and the grains are tender.
Stir in the butter, cheese and pepper until melted and creamy, and serve at once.
notes: Add a splash of hot water if it stiffens before serving.
Serve under braised meats or roasted vegetables.

recipes.title: Pumpkin and Sage Rice Cakes
recipes.summary: Golden pan-fried cakes made from pumpkin and sage risotto, crisp outside and soft inside.
steps: Mix the rice, pumpkin, sage, cheese, eggs, flour and salt in a bowl until it holds together.
Shape into 8 patties and chill for 15 minutes.
Fry in the oil over medium heat for 4 minutes each side until golden and heated through.
Drain on paper towel and serve hot with a green salad and lemon wedges.
notes: Chilling the patties helps them hold their shape.
Food safety: fry until golden and hot throughout, and cool and refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: Cheese and Herb Scones for Soup
recipes.summary: Savoury scones with cheddar and chives, ideal for dunking into soup.
steps: Heat the oven to 220C and line a tray. Rub the butter into the flour and salt until like breadcrumbs.
Stir in the cheddar and chives, then add the milk and mix gently with a knife until a soft dough forms.
Pat out to 3cm thick, cut into 8 rounds, place on the tray and brush with beaten egg.
Bake for 18 minutes until risen, golden and cooked through.
notes: Do not overwork the dough or the scones will be tough.
Food safety: bake until golden and cooked through in the middle.

recipes.title: Herbed Cornbread with Jalapeno
recipes.summary: A moist cornbread with jalapeno and fresh herbs, baked in a tin.
steps: Heat the oven to 200C and grease a 20cm square tin.
Mix the cornmeal, flour, baking powder and salt in a bowl.
Whisk the eggs, milk, butter and honey, pour into the dry mix with the jalapeno and chives and stir until just combined.
Pour into the tin and bake for 25 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean.
notes: Serve warm with butter or alongside chilli and soup.
Food safety: bake until a skewer comes out clean. Wash fresh produce well, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat them within 3 days.

recipes.title: Asparagus Soup with Lemon Cream
recipes.summary: A silky green asparagus soup finished with a swirl of lemon cream.
steps: Heat the oil in a pot and cook the onion for 5 minutes over medium heat until soft, then add the potato, asparagus, stock and salt.
Simmer for 15 minutes until the potato and asparagus are very tender.
Blend until smooth, then stir in half the cream and half the lemon juice and reheat until steaming.
Whip the remaining cream with the zest and pepper, spoon over the soup and serve.
notes: Save a few tips to garnish.
Do not boil after adding the cream.
Food safety: Reheat leftovers until steaming hot right through.

recipes.title: Seafood Chowder with Dill
recipes.summary: A creamy chowder of white fish, prawns and potato with sweet corn and fresh dill.

items: 300g white fish fillet, cut in chunks

steps: Melt the butter in a large pot and cook the onion and celery for 5 minutes over medium heat until soft.
Add the potato and stock and simmer for 12 minutes until the potato is tender.
Add the milk, corn and fish and simmer gently for 4 minutes, then add the prawns and cook for 3 minutes until the fish flakes and the prawns are pink and opaque.
Stir in the dill and salt and serve hot.
notes: Keep the heat low once the milk goes in so it does not curdle.
Food safety: cook fish and prawns until opaque and 63°C inside; eat leftovers within 1 day and reheat until piping hot.

recipes.title: Silverbeet and Ricotta Egg Muffins
recipes.summary: Make-ahead egg muffins packed with silverbeet, ricotta and a little parmesan.
steps: Heat the oven to 180C and grease a 6-hole muffin tin with the oil.
Wilt the silverbeet in a hot pan for 2 minutes until soft, cool slightly and squeeze dry.
Whisk the eggs, ricotta, silverbeet, spring onion, cheese, salt and pepper and divide among the holes.
Bake for 25 minutes until puffed, golden and set in the centre.
notes: Keep refrigerated and reheat until hot for weekday breakfasts.
Food safety: bake until the centres are fully set; refrigerate within 2 hours and eat within 3 days, reheating until piping hot.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake Porridge with Walnuts
recipes.summary: Creamy rolled oats cooked with grated carrot, cinnamon and sultanas, topped with walnuts.
steps: Combine the oats, milk, carrot, cinnamon and nutmeg in a saucepan.
Cook over medium heat, stirring, for 8 minutes until thick and creamy.
Stir in the sultanas and maple syrup, then spoon into bowls and top with the walnuts and yoghurt.
notes: Add a splash of milk if you like it looser.
Swap the walnuts for pecans or almonds.

recipes.title: Corn and Capsicum Breakfast Tacos with Scrambled Egg
recipes.summary: Soft tortillas filled with fluffy scrambled egg, charred corn and capsicum.
steps: Heat the oil in a pan and cook the capsicum and corn over high heat for 4 minutes until charred and tender.
Pour in the eggs and salt and stir over low heat for 3 minutes until the egg is just set.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds each side.
Fill the tortillas with the egg mixture, top with avocado and coriander and serve with lime.
notes: Keep the egg soft but fully set.
Food safety: cook eggs until set with no liquid egg remaining; avoid undercooked eggs for young children, pregnant women and older adults.

recipes.title: Tofu and Mushroom Hot Pot with Rice Noodles
recipes.summary: A fragrant ginger broth simmered with vegetables, tofu and rice noodles.
steps: Bring the stock, ginger and soy sauce to a simmer in a large pot and cook for 8 minutes until fragrant.
Add the mushrooms and tofu and simmer for 4 minutes until tender.
Add the rice noodles and cook for 4 minutes until tender, then add the bok choy for 2 minutes until wilted.
Stir in the sesame oil, scatter with spring onion and serve in bowls.
notes: Soak the noodles first if they are very thick.
Add chilli oil at the table if you like heat.
